Class LinuxNetworkParams

java.lang.Object
oshi.software.common.AbstractNetworkParams
oshi.software.common.os.linux.LinuxNetworkParams
All Implemented Interfaces:
NetworkParams
@ThreadSafe public abstract class LinuxNetworkParams extends AbstractNetworkParams
Linux network parameters. Provides the host name and default gateway implementations shared by all backends. The JNA and FFM subclasses override AbstractNetworkParams.getDomainName() with a native call; the native-free subclass inherits the Java-based resolution from AbstractNetworkParams.

    • getRoutes

      public List<NetworkParams.IPRoute> getRoutes()
      Description copied from interface: NetworkParams
      Gets the operating system's routing table, containing both IPv4 and IPv6 routes. Each NetworkParams.IPRoute carries its own address family in the length of its destination address.

      The routing table is read fresh on each call and is not cached.

      Platform notes: Windows reads the table from the IP Helper API and Linux from /proc/net/route and /proc/net/ipv6_route; the remaining platforms parse netstat. No platform requires elevated privileges. Not every platform publishes every field; see NetworkParams.IPRoute for the sentinel each unavailable field reports.

      Returns:
      A list of NetworkParams.IPRoute objects, or an empty list if the routing table could not be read.
